blocks.subtitle: Your cellular reserve
blocks.claim: Telomeres are the protective caps at the ends of your chromosomes. Their length is regarded as a marker of cumulative cellular strain and regenerative capacity — measured from a drop of capillary blood.
blocks.footer: Polaris Diagnostics Europe GmbH · Hamburg · www.polarisdx.net
blocks.benefit: Where your client's cellular reserve stands — and what in everyday life acts on it.

blocks.caption: The principle
blocks.title: Your telomeres. Your cellular reserve.
blocks.lead: Telomeres stabilise the DNA at every cell division and prevent the loss of genetic information. With each division they become a little shorter. If they fall below a critical length, cells lose their ability to divide or enter senescence — a central driver of biological ageing.

cards.title: Protection
cards.text: How stably your DNA is protected and how efficiently repair mechanisms work.

cards.title: Regeneration
cards.text: How much division reserve your cells retain and how resilient your tissue remains.

cards.title: Context
cards.text: How your telomere length compares with an age- and sex-matched reference group.

flow.title: Measure
flow.text: Dried blood spot card, fingertip. Telomere length as a relative quantification by qPCR. No fasting required.

flow.title: Contextualise
flow.text: Comparison with an age- and sex-matched reference group. 112 kbp corresponds to the reference value (100 %).

flow.title: Change
flow.text: Telomeres cannot be lengthened in isolation. What matters is slowing the processes that accelerate their shortening.

blocks.title: How robust is this value?
blocks.text: Telomere length measurement by qPCR varies considerably — between individual runs and between laboratories. DNA extraction, storage and the composition of the blood cells systematically influence the result. From dried blood this variation is higher than from venous blood. For diagnostic questions, flow-FISH is regarded as the superior method.
items: What this means in practice: a deviation of a few per cent from the reference value is of the same order of magnitude as the measurement variation and is not meaningful in itself. The analysis only becomes robust across several measurements taken under the same conditions — same laboratory, same material, comparable sample collection.
Telomere length is a marker of cumulative cellular strain. It is not a diagnosis, not a statement about life expectancy and not a measure of individual disease risk.

blocks.caption: Your result
blocks.title: Your telomere length.
blocks.lead: Telomere length · cellular stability. Relative quantification against the reference value of 112 kbp (= 100 %).
blocks.text: Your telomere length is 4 % below the value expected for your age. This gives a telomere-based biological age of 53 years, five years above your chronological age. For context: a deviation of 4 % is of the same order of magnitude as the variation that qPCR measurements from dried blood show between runs. The value should therefore be read as a starting point for the trend, not as a precise single determination.

blocks.caption: Where you stand
blocks.title: Diet and lifestyle habits.
blocks.lead: The radar shows how close your current habits are to the reference values. The further out a factor lies, the more favourable — 10 is optimal.

scores.label: Diet
scores.text: Good nutrient combination, room for improvement in the details.

scores.label: Lifestyle
scores.text: Balanced, with room for more exercise and stress reduction.

notices: Not smoking (tobacco 9 out of 10) is the factor with the strongest documented relation to telomere length — and in your case already well above average.
Stress (4 out of 10) is your weakest lifestyle factor and the area with the greatest scope for improvement.
Exercise (7) and everyday activity (6) have room to grow; regular physical activity is among the measures with a documented relation to telomere biology.
blocks.note: Assessment based on your own self-reported information, not an individual diagnosis. The relationships mentioned are group findings from the literature, not a prediction for the individual case.

blocks.caption: All recommendations at a glance
blocks.title: Your interventions.
blocks.lead: Telomeres cannot be lengthened deliberately. All measures aim to slow the processes that accelerate their shortening — oxidative strain and impaired methylation.

blocks.caption: Trend
blocks.title: The actual finding.
blocks.lead: Because a single value does not reliably overcome the variation of the method, the informative value lies in the trend. Only measured values are shown — no prognosis.

blocks.title: What the trend shows
blocks.text: The telomere-based age has fallen by two years between the two measurements, from 55 to 53 — while the chronological age rose by three months at the same time. The direction is right.
items: At the same time: telomeres do not lengthen appreciably. An improvement of this magnitude is therefore more likely attributable to measurement variation than to actual lengthening. Only a direction that stays the same across several measurements permits a conclusion.

Roughly three months lay between the two measurements. The interval to the next check is set by the supervising institution. For comparability, the laboratory, sample material and sample collection should remain the same.

blocks.caption: Summary
blocks.title: Two levers, and one is the bigger one.
blocks.lead: Eight measures appear in this report. They differ considerably in the strength of the evidence behind them — that should determine the order in which you tackle them.

focuses.title: Lifestyle — the factor with the strongest evidence
focuses.text: According to your report, not smoking, moderate alcohol consumption and regular exercise are the greatest demonstrable influencing factor on telomere length. Two of these are already well established in your case: tobacco stands at 9 out of 10 on the radar, alcohol at 6. Specifically: the lever lies in physical activity — exercise 7 out of 10, everyday activity 6 out of 10. At least 150 minutes per week.

focuses.title: Methylation nutrients
focuses.text: Five of the eight measures — folate, B2, B12, B6 and methionine — act via the same metabolic pathway. In practice this means: two portions of green leafy vegetables daily (raw or briefly steamed, because folate is heat-sensitive), eggs or cheese for B12, 2–3 Brazil nuts. Plus 3–4 cups of green tea and at least 30 g of fibre.

blocks.keepText: Not smoking (9/10), fruit and vegetables (8/10) and fluid intake (8/10) are well above the reference group, and the diet score of 72/100 is solid. And the trend points in the right direction.
controlItems: Telomeres cannot be deliberately lengthened through diet or lifestyle. All measures aim to slow the shortening. Whether this is reflected in your personal value can, given the measurement variation, only be judged across several measurements — not from the next single figure.

blocks.caption: What is established — and what is not
blocks.title: Scientific context.
blocks.lead: We set out the limits of this analysis openly, because an honest interpretation is worth more than an impressive number.

items.title: Variation
items.text: Considerable — between runs and between laboratories

items.title: Influencing factors
items.text: DNA extraction, storage and cell composition have a systematic effect

items.title: Sample material
items.text: Higher variation from dried blood than from venous blood

items.title: For diagnostic questions
items.text: Flow-FISH is regarded as the superior method

items.title: What the analysis is suited for
items.text: As a counselling and trend tool: it puts cellular strain on the agenda, creates a concrete occasion to act and, through repeated measurements under the same conditions, provides a trend line.

items.title: What it is not suited for
items.text: As diagnostics, as a statement about life expectancy or individual disease risk — and as a precise single determination, as long as the deviation is of the same order of magnitude as the measurement variation.

blocks.title: The underlying principle
blocks.text: The trend carries weight, the single value does not. An initial and a follow-up measurement under the same conditions are the actual benefit of this analysis.
items: For comparability, the laboratory, sample material and sample collection must remain the same — changing the laboratory means two values are no longer comparable.

blocks.title: Questions about your report?
blocks.text: Discuss the results with the institution that carried out the sample collection. That is where the context needed for interpretation is available.

legal.title: Interpretation
legal.text: Telomere length is determined by qPCR as a relative value. This method varies considerably between runs and between laboratories; from dried blood the variation is higher than from venous blood. The report is not a diagnosis, not a statement about life expectancy and not a measure of individual disease risk. Informative value only emerges across several measurements under the same conditions.
